title: iPhone Duo pre-order live blog: New phones won’t arrive until 2027 now
content:
Macworld

If feels like it’s been a month since Apple unveiled its first folding phone, the iPhone Duo, and, well, it has. Announced on September 9 at the “Surprise and Shine” event, it finally goes up for pre-order this morning at 8 am ET before hitting shelves next Friday.

If you want one, however, you’re going to have to act fast. Not since the iPhone X has a phone been more anticipated, and even Apple is warning users that “demand will be high” for the new phone, and we’ve been reading reports about production constraints for weeks. So we expect to see delivery dates slipping into December very quickly.

There are two colors to choose from (Night Sky and Star White) and four storage configurations with the following prices:

  • 256GB: $1,999
  • 512GB: $2,199
  • 1TB: $2,599
  • 2TB: $3,199

The point of this live blog is simple: We’re going to track all colors and configurations in the U.S. and U.K. Apple stores (and other retailers) to tell you how quick ship dates start slipping, which colors and configurations are available, and what you can still get before 2027. We’ll try to update every few minutes, but it’s the first time we’re trying this, so bear with us.

iPhone Duo pre-order live blog

1 day ago, By Michael Simon

Let the gouging begin

As expected, with ship dates slipping into next year, people are already selling iPhone Duos on eBay for hundreds more than they paid. This 1TB model already sold for $3,777.77, more than a thousand dollars more than the MSRP. And that’s just the beginning.

Has the limit been reached?

It’s been about a half-hour since Apple began quoting January 25 for new iPhone Duo pre-orders and it hasn’t changed. The same date applies to all colors, capacities, and carriers, so it appears as though shipping estimates have been capped at three months. Based on my experience with Apple pre-orders, new phones will likely ship at least a week or two before that date, but supply will be constrained at least through the holidays. So if you managed to buy one for shipping this year, congrats.

Which comes first, Duo or M5 Ultra?

Currentlym the Duo is quoting January 25, while the Mac Studio with 256GB of RAM isn’t expected to deliver until February 23. At least you can gain a little interest in the meantime.

Pre-ordering tips

I won’t be buying an iPhone Duo this morning, but I’ve participated in my share of early-morning pre-ordering. I have a couple of tips.

Use two devices. The online store and the app load differently, so it’s best to have a Mac with Safari open and an iPhone with the Apple Store app open. You can’t refresh the app, but you can quit and reopen if you want to force it to reload.

Don’t give up. The store likely won’t open until at least a couple of minutes after 8 am. Whether it’s purposeful or not, Apple usually opens its stores 5 or 10 minutes after the published time. So don’t get discouraged if you still see the splash screen as late as 8:10 am.

Use Apple Pay. Apple’s online payment method isn’t just convenient, it’s much quicker than going through Apple’s full checkout process. You’ll save a minute or so by just tapping the Apple Pay button.

Don’t buy anything else. Forget about case or accessories, you can get those later. To get the quickest ship time, just buy the phone and check out quickly.

Of those, 22% are getting a higher-capacity model, while the colors for the 256GB model are split pretty evenly: 15% for Night Sky and 13% for Star White. Good luck everyone!
